preconditions.description: For each test case, all edges (x_i, y_i) satisfy 0 ≤ x_i, y_i ≤ N, where N is the number of nodes minus one.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a line of N positive integers (the lexicographically smallest sequence A) or '-1' if no such sequence exists.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() != '-1')
postconditions.description: If the output is a sequence, it contains exactly N positive integers.
